in_sanskrit.name: अर्ज्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is worthy of being worshipped, respected and revered.

in_marathi.name: Arjya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjya means worthy or deserving. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna, the great warrior, was known as Arjya for his virtuous deeds and righteousness.

in_bengali.name: Arjya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Worthy, Deserving
in_bengali.long_meaning: Arjya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Arjya means worthy or deserving. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna, the great warrior, was known as Arjya for his virtuous deeds and righteousness.
